# IFC Fixtures

Do not add arbitrary third-party models without recording redistribution rights.

Each fixture must have companion metadata containing:

- source / authoring application and version;
- export plugin/version when known;
- IFC schema and container format;
- units;
- expected project/site/building/storey/element counts;
- expected bounds;
- geometry/material edge cases;
- license or permission to redistribute.

Large or proprietary Revit source files must not be committed here.
